visualUniverse: Wet forest at night. Rusted gym equipment. Sweat on black cotton. Worn dark leather. Smoke trapped in cold air. Black coffee. Rain on metal. Old injuries. Amber streetlight through fog. Rugged, animalic, exhausted, masculine, strangely expensive. Single accent: cold steel grey.

imageBriefs.1: Rugged anonymous antihero silhouette, wet forest at night, back partly turned, soaked black leather jacket, rain, smoke, amber light between trees. No claws, logos or suit.
imageBriefs.2: Dim bedroom before sunrise: unmade bed, broken alarm clock, one worn boot, muscular forearm beside mattress. Cold light, black cotton. Generous negative space.
imageBriefs.3: Extreme close-up: rain-dampened stubble, weathered jawline, black leather collar, cigarette-like smoke. No identifiable face. Fragrance campaign, not grooming.
imageBriefs.4: Empty underground gym at night: sweat-soaked black shirt over a scarred barbell, chalk dust, wet concrete, one harsh overhead light.
imageBriefs.5: Solitary man in dark leather jacket walking away into rain-soaked forest, back to camera, fog, distant warm light. Darkest frame.
imageBriefs.6: Unbranded black bottle silhouette on wet black stone, scorched wood, resin tears, tobacco leaf, black coffee cup, incense smoke, rain. Never imitate the official bottle or label.
imageBriefs.7: Scratched steel flask on a wet tree stump, claw-like marks in the wood, mist, ash, rain, near-black trees. No person. Minimal.

seriesLabel: How to smell like you’re the problem
